title: Account Executive
description:
Roles and Responsibilities 
 Manage accounts payable process from payment initiation to finalization.
 Ensure timely payment of bills and maintain accurate records.
 Prepare and review balance sheets, profit & loss statements, and cash flow statements.
 Conduct bank reconciliations to ensure accuracy of financial transactions.
 Maintain TDS compliance by preparing challans and submitting them on time.

Key Skills: Accounts payable,Accounting,TDS,Tally,Payables
